summary: Iteration 144 - RBAC Roles & Permissions Module fully tested. Backend: 38/38 tests passed. All CRUD operations working correctly. Frontend: All UI components verified - Role Builder with 6 template tiles, permission tree with 15 categories, Select All/Deselect All, Global Admin switch, Create/Edit/Clone/Delete flows.

tests: GET /api/rbac/catalog returns catalog, templates, total_permissions, all_permission_keys
GET /api/rbac/catalog has 6 templates (receptionist, housekeeper, manager, accountant, laundry_staff, maintenance)
Each category has key, label, sub_groups with permissions
GET /api/rbac/roles returns roles array with total and total_permissions_available
GET /api/rbac/roles?q=search filters by key or display_name
POST /api/rbac/roles creates role with key, display_name, permissions, is_global_admin
POST /api/rbac/roles validates key regex (lowercase letters, digits, underscores)
POST /api/rbac/roles rejects duplicate key per branch (400)
POST /api/rbac/roles with template=receptionist expands to 19 permissions
POST /api/rbac/roles with template=manager expands to ALL 313 permissions
GET /api/rbac/roles/{role_id} returns role with assigned_users count
PUT /api/rbac/roles/{role_id} key is immutable (not in update model)
GET /api/roles still works (returns roles and departments objects)
Sidebar entry (data-testid=roles-permissions-btn) opens Roles panel (admin only)
New Role button (data-testid=new-role-btn) opens Role Builder
Clicking template tile loads permissions and shows SELECTED indicator
Role Name input (role-key-input) auto-lowercases and strips invalid chars
Role Name input is disabled in edit mode (key immutable)
Display Name input (role-display-input) is free text
Each category shows selected/total badge and Select All link
MENU badge shown for menu:true permissions
Master Select All (select-all-perms) and Deselect All (deselect-all-perms) work
Create Role button (role-save-btn) POSTs and returns to list
New role appears in list with permission count and 0 assigned users
Clone icon (role-clone-{id}) prompts for new_key and creates copy
Edit icon (role-edit-{id}) opens builder with key field disabled
Delete icon (role-delete-{id}) removes role after confirmation

critical_code_review_comments: PERMISSION_CATALOG correctly defines 313 permissions across 15 categories
ROLE_TEMPLATES correctly defines 6 quick-start templates with permission lists
Manager template uses '__ALL__' which expands to all 313 permissions
Role key validation uses regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,49}$ (2-50 chars, starts with letter)
Role key is immutable - not included in RoleUpdate model
Clone correctly records cloned_from_id and cloned_from_key
Delete correctly blocks when users are assigned (400)
Legacy /api/roles endpoint preserved and working (no conflict with /api/rbac/roles)
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Frontend correctly disables key input in edit mode
seed_data_creation: Test roles created during testing were cleaned up (test_playwright_role, cloned_test_role). Some test roles from backend tests may remain (test_* prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 144 tested the new RBAC Roles & Permissions module. Backend has /api/rbac/catalog (313 perms, 15 cats, 6 templates) and /api/rbac/roles CRUD endpoints. Frontend has RolesPermissionsPanel with Role Builder, template tiles, permission tree, and full CRUD UI. Legacy /api/roles endpoint still works. All data-testid attributes are in place for automated testing.
